title: Hold more than one role and switch between them
description: Someone who is, say, both a team leader and the manager now switches roles from the top bar, and signs in next time as whichever they used last.
items: The role switcher sits at the top of every page, and only appears for people with more than one role
Approve each step as the role it belongs to: someone who is both team leader and manager signs the team leader step, switches, then signs the final step
A bar under the top bar says when work is waiting under another role you hold, with a button to switch to it
Admin is IT: users and roles, company settings and the audit trail are theirs alone
The business manager and CEO see every department and report
HR screens, now including Events, are open to the manager and above as well as to HR
